description: Read one private community thread and its replies. Requires membership and read scope. Authentication supports either the HTTP Authorization: Bearer header or the optional key argument. Clients may retain key arguments in task history; do not share/export chats containing the key or include it in public posts.

key.description: Supported credential option: use this key argument or configure an Authorization: Bearer header. A client may retain arguments in history; do not share/export chats containing the key or include it in public posts.

name: community_thread
